help.text:
Usage: modelfile-doctor [OPTIONS] PATH...
       modelfile-doctor demo [--out DIR]
       modelfile-doctor inspect FILE.gguf

Check Ollama Modelfiles before `ollama create`: syntax, PARAMETER values, the Go
template, and (the part Ollama does not do) TEMPLATE/stop against the GGUF metadata.

Options:
  --lang en|ko        output language (default: $MODELFILE_DOCTOR_LANG, then LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG)
  --format text|json  output format (default: text)
  --strict            exit 1 on warnings too
  --ollama [URL]      resolve model names through a local Ollama server
                      (default: $OLLAMA_HOST or http://127.0.0.1:11434)
  --select IDS        only these rule ids or prefixes, comma separated (e.g. CT,MF011)
  --ignore IDS        skip these rule ids or prefixes, comma separated
  --no-color          never use colors
  --list-rules        list all rules and exit
  --version           print the version and exit
  -h, --help          show this help

Exit codes: 0 no errors, 1 errors (or warnings with --strict), 2 usage or I/O problem.
help.demo:
Usage: modelfile-doctor demo [--out DIR] [--lang en|ko]

Build a tiny synthetic GGUF (no weights) with a good and a bad Modelfile and check both.
Without --out the files live in a temporary directory that is removed afterwards.
help.inspect:
Usage: modelfile-doctor inspect FILE.gguf [--format text|json] [--lang en|ko]

Print the metadata this tool compares against (header only, tensors are not read).
err.cli.usage: Invalid usage: {detail}. Run with --help to see the options.
err.cli.bad_lang: Unsupported language "{value}". Use --lang en or --lang ko.
err.cli.bad_format: Unsupported format "{value}". Use --format text or --format json.
err.cli.no_paths: No Modelfile given. Pass at least one path, e.g. modelfile-doctor Modelfile.
err.cli.unknown_rule: Unknown rule id "{value}". Run --list-rules to see the valid ids.
err.io.permission: No permission to read "{path}". Check the file permissions.
err.io.is_directory: "{path}" is a directory, not a file. Pass the Modelfile itself.
err.modelfile.is_gguf: "{path}" is a GGUF model file, not a Modelfile. Pass the Modelfile, or run `modelfile-doctor inspect {path}` to read the model file.
err.modelfile.too_large: "{path}" is larger than {limit_mib} MiB, which is far too big for a Modelfile. Check that you passed the right file.
err.io.cannot_create: Cannot create files in "{path}": {detail}. Pick a directory you can write to with --out.
err.decode.invalid: "{path}" is not valid text (undecodable byte at offset {offset}). Save it as UTF-8.
err.gguf.bad_magic: "{path}" is not a GGUF file (wrong magic bytes).
err.gguf.truncated: "{path}" is truncated or corrupt: it ends inside the GGUF header.
err.gguf.unsupported_version: "{path}" uses GGUF version {version}; only versions 2 and 3 are supported.
err.gguf.unsupported_type: "{path}" contains an unsupported GGUF value type ({type}).
err.gguf.bad_value: "{path}" contains a string that is not valid UTF-8.
err.ollama.unreachable: Cannot reach Ollama at {url} ({detail}). Start it with `ollama serve` or pass --ollama URL.
err.ollama.timeout: Ollama at {url} did not answer in time. Try again when the server is idle.
err.ollama.model_not_found: Ollama at {url} does not know the model "{name}". Run `ollama pull {name}` first.
err.ollama.bad_response: Ollama at {url} sent an unexpected answer. Is that really an Ollama server?
summary.totals: Summary: {errors} error(s), {warnings} warning(s), {infos} info in {files} file(s)
demo.banner: practice fixture: synthetic GGUF without weights (nothing here is a real model)
demo.dir_temp: Files were written to a temporary directory ({path}) and are removed afterwards. Use --out DIR to keep them.
demo.lesson: Modelfile.bad has a ChatML model with a Llama 2 template; `ollama create` would still print success. Try it on your own model: modelfile-doctor Modelfile
inspect.name: name:           {value}
rule.MF001: File is not plain UTF-8 (BOM or UTF-16).
rule.MF012: PARAMETER value has the wrong type.
rule.MF013: PARAMETER value outside the usual range.
rule.MF014: MESSAGE role must be system, user or assistant.
rule.MF016: Suspicious stop value (empty or unquoted spaces).
rule.MF020: FROM path missing or not a GGUF file.
rule.TP002: Jinja syntax in a Go template.
rule.CT001: Turn-end token of the model missing from stop.
rule.CT002: Role tokens of the model's chat template missing from TEMPLATE.
rule.CT003: TEMPLATE uses a token the model does not know or never uses.
rule.CT004: stop value is a token the model never produces.
rule.CT005: num_ctx is larger than the model's context length.
rule.CT010: FROM is a model name; comparison skipped without --ollama.
rule.CT011: Model metadata could not be read; comparison skipped.
diag.MF001: File encoding is {encoding}. Save it as UTF-8 without BOM (PowerShell redirection writes UTF-16).
diag.MF002: No FROM line. Add one, e.g. FROM ./model.gguf.
diag.MF003: The quote of {name} is never closed.
diag.MF010: PARAMETER {name} is deprecated; Ollama drops it.
diag.MF011.suggest: Unknown PARAMETER "{name}". Did you mean "{suggestion}"? (names are case-sensitive)
diag.MF012: PARAMETER {name} needs a value of type {kind}, got "{value}".
diag.MF013: PARAMETER {name} = {value} is outside the usual range ({range}).
diag.MF014: MESSAGE role "{role}" must be system, user or assistant (lower case).
diag.MF015: {name} is already set on line {first_line}; the later one wins.
diag.MF016.space: PARAMETER stop value "{value}" contains spaces; wrap it in double quotes.
diag.MF020.not_gguf: FROM file "{path}" is not a GGUF file.
diag.TP001.unclosed: A template action starts with the opening braces but never closes.
diag.TP001.stray: A closing brace pair has no opening braces.
diag.TP002: Jinja syntax "{token}" found. Ollama TEMPLATE is a Go template, not Jinja.
diag.TP004: The {block} block is never closed with an end action.
diag.TP005.suggest: Unknown template variable .{name}. Did you mean .{suggestion}?
diag.TP006: TEMPLATE uses .Messages together with .Prompt/.Response; Ollama fills only one of them.
diag.CT001: The model ends its turn with {token}, but PARAMETER stop does not list it.
diag.CT002: The model's chat template uses {tokens}, but TEMPLATE does not contain them.
diag.CT003.missing: TEMPLATE uses {token}, which is not in this model's vocabulary (it would be read as plain text).
diag.CT003.unused: TEMPLATE uses {token}, which this model's chat template never uses.
diag.CT004: stop "{token}" is a token this model never produces.
diag.CT005: num_ctx {num_ctx} is larger than the model's context length {context_length}.
diag.CT010: FROM "{name}" is a model name, so TEMPLATE/stop were not compared. Pass --ollama to compare.
diag.CT011: Model metadata could not be read ({reason}); comparison skipped.
